However, the finding’s claimed impact (“handleCancelBooking only deletes video meetings whose reference has a credentialId, so Zoom/Daily meetings are left behind”) is not verifiable from the provided diff: the shown `handleCancelBooking` changes only process `*_calendar` references (filtering `reference.type.includes("_calendar")`) and do not show any video-meeting deletion logic or any dependency on `credentialId` for video references. Therefore the asserted regression about silently leaving Zoom/Daily meetings behind cannot be confirmed from this diff alone.
